user_prompt_summary: Human asked orchestrator to run the weekly job-search cycle.
Orchestrator asked researcher to find new Staff/Principal SWE listings.
Researcher found 3 matching listings and saved each as a Markdown file.
Researcher reported completion back to orchestrator.
Orchestrator's broadcast triggered todo-agent to build the application todo list.
Todo-agent scanned memory/listings/*.md and found 3 files.
Todo-agent wrote memory/todos/2026-09-15.md with one application task per listing.
Orchestrator confirmed the todo list was created and reported success to the human.
